'''0.19b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added purchase confirmations and decreased the effectiveness of the Onyx [[Artifacts|artifact]].

==Changelog==
* A message to confirm your purchase in store will now be displayed
* When attempting to buy an item you already own, a pop-up window to confirm the purchase will be displayed
* The active time of 'Onyx' [[Artifacts|artifact]] has been reduced to 3 seconds
* The cooldown time for the 'Onyx' artifact increased to 60 seconds
* The oxygen tank capacity reduced to 20 seconds. The protection provided by the oxygen tank has been increased
* The respirator protection value has been increased
* Anomaly damage on the [[Radar]] location has been lowered

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed a bug leading to sped-up reputation gain
* Fixed a bug allowing the 'Deliver X batteries' quest to be accomplished by yourself
* Fixed a bug with the ammo sold in shop being unusable with shotguns
* Fixed a bug with the mouse-pointer movement making it impossible to open part of the interface windows at certain resolutions
